title: Rental deposit rules
question: How much deposit can a landlord charge and when must it be returned?
short_answer: Deposit cannot exceed 3 months rent and must be returned within 30 days of vacating.
conditions: Must be returned within 30 days after the tenant vacates
Landlord may deduct costs for damages beyond normal wear and tear
Deductions must be documented with receipts
Deposit amount and return terms must be stated in the rental contract
exceptions: Social housing (komunalne) may have different rules
penalties: Landlord who fails to return deposit can be sued in civil court
Court can order return plus interest and legal costs
Small claims court (e-sąd) is available for amounts under 75,000 PLN

sources.title: Ustawa o ochronie praw lokatorów – Sejm RP
